title: Neurophenomenology bridges the explanatory gap rather than closing it

statements.text: Neurophenomenology does not aim to close the explanatory gap by ontological reduction but to bridge it at epistemological and methodological levels through reciprocal constraints. It does not claim to have built those bridges, only to propose a research program for building them.

sources.quote: neurophenomenology does not aim to close the gap in the sense of ontological reduction, but rather to bridge the gap at epistemological and methodological levels
